title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement:
Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within a string. The task is to identify the longest contiguous substring where no character appears more than once and return its length.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces
The answer is guaranteed to be unique

visibleExamples.explanation: The longest substring without repeating characters is "abc" with length 3.
The longest substring without repeating characters is "b" with length 1.
The longest substring without repeating characters is "wke" with length 3.
